author: Trinity Harden
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
dbplyr_con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(dbplyr_con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(dbplyr_con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(dbplyr_con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(avg_minutes = mean(minutes, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
keep_cats <- c(
  "Personal Care Activities",
  "Household Activities",
  "Caring For & Helping Household (HH) Members",
  "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
)

hourly_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  mutate(hour = start_hhmm %/% 100L) |>
  filter(hour >= 6L, hour <= 23L) |>
  left_join(dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
            by = "activity_code") |>
  filter(major_name %in% keep_cats) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_resp |>
               filter(str_starts(employment_status, "Not"),
                      day_type == "Weekday") |>
               select(tucaseid, sex),
             by = "tucaseid") |>
  group_by(sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarize(avg_min = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()

hourly_avg
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = fct_reorder(major_name, avg_minutes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_minutes, y = major_name, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Weekday Activity Time",
    subtitle = "Respondents not in the labor force, by sex",
    x = "Average daily minutes",
    y = "Major activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hourly_avg, aes(x = hour, y = avg_min, fill = major_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(6, 23, by = 3),
    labels = \(x) sprintf("%02d:00", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How the Weekday Fills Up",
    subtitle = "Average minutes spent in activities starting each hour",
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Major activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```
